## Activity

During May 2026, Market Eye Clinic completed 425 retinal image captures. Overall activity was delivered as planned, with session lists managed through the month. Routine leave was accommodated within the existing arrangements and did not prevent completion of the scheduled work.

The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the site. No operational issue was identified in the available report that would require a change to the established session arrangements.

## Image quality

There were 102 ungradable image sets. This represented an ungradable rate of 24.0 per cent of all captures. The result should continue to be monitored through routine site review, with attention to image acquisition and any recurring factors affecting image assessability.

## Grading

A total of 101 results were graded as referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This indicates that grading activity continued alongside image capture during the reporting month. The site should maintain its current monitoring of referral outcomes, grading turnaround, and image quality as part of regular operational oversight.
